description: dbSNP variant lookup — Look up up to 10 dbSNP variants at once by rsID (rs= comma-separated, e.g. rs7412,rs429358): chromosome, GRCh38 and GRCh37 positions, alleles (ref/alt), the gene the variant sits in, and a dbSNP link, plus a count of variants per gene. Source: NCBI dbSNP via the NLM Clinical Table Search Service (US government, public domain). Reference data, not a genetic interpretation. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: health_snp
